lines: Devang Mehta, Investor Selling Shareholder, can receive up to ₹2.25 crore if all offered shares are sold; shares unlocked 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago.
Proceeds are up to ₹2.25 crore from selling up to 16,650 shares; actual proceeds slightly lower as employee-portion shares sell at a discount.
Gain of up to ₹1.66 crore before offer expenses and taxes; retained holding estimated at ₹5.25 crore at offer price.
Money is already in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago); confidence medium, as holdings appear in one section only.
